posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I am so excited by these.  Gah!

This is just the inspiration I need to finally purchase the oversized villain cards.

Dark Watch Expatriette is awesome.  Hairtrigger reflexes for the win!

And also, end of turn. . . that's a nice power.  Real nice.

Fixer, um, Yes Please!!  Bloody knuckles is now the greatest card ever.

Play Knuckles, Use power, destroy Knuckles.

5 damage before tools or styles or meditation?  boom!!  and no nasty side effects from getting your hands bloody.  Apparently none of it is your blood.

His lack of a non-explosive power means he'll be sitting for certain turns waiting, but when he strikes, it is going to bring the pain.

The Question:  Does Bitter strike count as Strike?  or is overdrive a wasted card.  I assume it would, which just really ups the cost of overdrive, will require planning before you use it.  My goodness, go ahead and hurt 'em Fixer.  Dang.

Tool box being explodable is awesome.

Nightmist takes a small step back in speed, but sets her deck up for that lovely Oblivion you've been dreaming of. (or anything else)

And setback, we know his alt. power before we know his base power. . . that's cool right?

I don't know how Setback's new one affects his deck, but the others appear to be much more about picking your shots and holding back a bit other times.

 

I'm so pumped right now.

McBehrer:

Also, it's not conditional, so you CAN use Charge and Bitter Strike on your first turn if you want.

Indeed it is not conditional, but even if YOU use Bitter Strike WHILE someone ELSE has a card in PLAY, YOU will HAVE to destroy their card, whether you played on Ongoing or Equipment card is irrelevant.
